reason: The README describes a vision guard and analysis tool whose primary purpose is converting images and other media or documents into text for text-only models while preventing image-related session failures.

summaries.zh: 将图像及部分文档、视频内容转换为文本供文本模型使用，并在请求前处理图像块以避免会话因不支持图像而失败。
summaries.en: Converts images and selected document or video content into text for text-only models while processing image blocks before requests to prevent unsupported-image session failures.

capabilities: Reads workspace image, PDF, DOCX, PPTX, video, and text files for analysis
Uses local OCR or a configured vision model to convert media content into text
Rewrites image blocks in session input or replayed history before model requests
Stores OCR cache and budget state under the configured dsh home directory
